All comparisons confirm:

- **Carbonum_leaf_spot**: large elliptical lesions with borders — no match

The test image shows a single small, white/cream circular spot on an otherwise healthy green corn leaf — this is a textbook match for **Holcus_spot**, which shows exactly this pattern (isolated white/cream circular spots on green corn leaves, as seen in the bottom panels of the Holcus reference collage).
